messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Paging: HIGH - Dedicated inference errors for customer NovaGrid in us-east-1. Error spike detected on rd-infer-novagrid cluster (503/timeout). Pager routed to #oncall-sre and #incidents. thread_ts=1767001234

kyle-sre: on it. pulling logs and tracing. linking runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/dedicated-inference-5xx

maria-sre: I'm 2nd level. Kyle, can you confirm whether this is a model runtime failure or infra (autoscaler, nodes)? Also tag @tara-cs so CSM is aware.

tara-cs: thanks — NovaGrid CSM here (Lina + Marcus are primary contacts). I'm standing by for impact summary so we can draft a customer note. Lina reachable via Slack and email, Marcus prefers phone.

jim-prod: observed: spike started ~+5m from alert. Requests to /v1/generate -> 503, CPU on proxies normal, but backend pods returning ERR_CONNECT. Traffic tried fallback to hosted but saw increased latency. No broad latency in other tenants.

kyle-sre: quick findings: several inference pods in rd-infer-novagrid were OOM-killed after a recent autoscaler config change (scale-down cooldown lowered). Sample kubectl output:

```
kubectl -n rd-infer get pods -l app=rd-infer-novagrid
rd-infer-7f8b9    0/1     CrashLoopBackOff  3   10m
rd-infer-8c2d1    1/1     Running          50m
rd-infer-9e3f7    0/1     CrashLoopBackOff  2   8m
```

logs show preStop eviction and oom: 
```
2026-03-15T14:20:34Z INF eviction: memory_pressure threshold exceeded
2026-03-15T14:20:35Z ERR runtime: allocate failed: out of memory
```

kyle-sre: action plan: 1) temporarily pin replica count (scale up to baseline), 2) revert autoscaler cooldown change, 3) drain and restart affected pods gracefully. Applying step 1 now.

ops-bot: command executed by kyle-sre: `kubectl -n rd-infer scale deployment/rd-infer-novagrid --replicas=6` (success)

maria-sre: Kyle, after scaling, start a canary test (small set of requests) to confirm model starts serving. I'll prepare rollback if config revert fails.

kyle-sre: canary started -> sending test payloads to private canary endpoint. First 20 requests: 0 errors, latency ~120ms. Gradually ramping.

tara-cs: draft status-page blurb (proposed) — please review/edit: 
"We are investigating degraded inference availability for NovaGrid's dedicated cluster in us-east-1. Some customer requests receive 503 errors. Our engineers have identified an autoscaler configuration regression and are rolling back the change and increasing replica capacity. Mitigation is in progress. We will update within 30 minutes. Affected customers: NovaGrid (dedicated cluster)."

maria-sre: quick edits to be more specific for enterprise audience: 
"We are investigating degraded inference availability impacting NovaGrid's dedicated inference cluster in us-east-1. Symptom: intermittent 503s and timeouts for inference requests. Root cause identified: an autoscaler cooldown/configuration change that triggered premature scale-downs, causing pod evictions. Mitigation: we have scaled replicas to baseline and are reverting the autoscaler change; traffic is being routed to healthy pods. Estimated recovery: 15-30 minutes. We will follow up with a full incident report."

tara-cs: ok will post that to status.redwood.ai/incidents as "Investigating" and send an enterprise notification to NovaGrid contacts. Draft enterprise notification (email/SMS) — please sign off: 

"Hello Lina / Marcus —

We're reaching out to let you know we're currently investigating degraded inference availability for your dedicated cluster in us-east-1. Some of your inference requests may return 503 or time out. Our engineers have identified an autoscaler configuration change as the likely cause and are rolling back the change and increasing replica capacity. We expect service recovery within 30 minutes and will provide an update when the cluster is fully stabilized.

If you have any immediate concerns or need a dedicated bridge, reply to this thread or contact your CSM (Tara).

- Redwood Inference Ops"

lina-park (NovaGrid): thanks Tara — we saw the errors on our side and opened an internal ticket. Please include our SRE (sre-lead@novagrid.com) in updates. Marcus is on standby for a bridge.

marcus-v (NovaGrid): priority: high. Please send SMS to +1-***-***-1212 if the issue persists >15m.

kyle-sre: autoscaler revert applied: `kubectl -n rd-infer apply -f autoscaler/rd-infer-novagrid-revert.yaml` — confirmed config rolled back. Monitoring error rate now.

ops-bot: metric alert cleared for 503 spike (alert_id: a-7745) — current 503 rate back to 4% (baseline 1-2%).

maria-sre: still monitoring. Kyle, can you start a controlled replacement of crashloop pods (rolling restart) and coordinate with infra if node-level pressure remains?

kyle-sre: rolling restart started: `kubectl -n rd-infer rollout restart deployment/rd-infer-novagrid` — replacing 2 pods at a time.

jim-prod: observed partial recovery in customer telemetry -> some requests are still seeing elevated latency but success rates improving. Hosting fallback removed for a portion of traffic.

tara-cs: sending enterprise update to NovaGrid now (copied Lina + Marcus + sre-lead@novagrid.com). Posting status page update.

incident-bot: status page update posted: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/1767001234 - state: Investigating -> Mitigating.

maria-sre: asking product/comms: recommend we include the following in the customer-facing post-mortem: exact timeline, root cause (autoscaler cooldown change), mitigation steps, impact window, and follow-up actions (autoscaler validation test, alert tuning). Also include what we did to avoid recurrence for enterprise dedicated clusters.

tara-cs: noted. I'll draft the customer post-mortem template and share in #customer-success after incident closes.

kyle-sre: rolling restart finished. Current metrics: 503 down to 1.5%, p95 latency for NovaGrid endpoints ~180ms. Moving to Observe.

maria-sre: moving to 'watch' state. Oncall handoff: @kyle-sre will continue monitoring for 2 hours; if stable, escalate to post-incident review.

tara-cs: sending final notification to NovaGrid: 
"Update: We have rolled back the autoscaler change and increased replica capacity; service is stable for the last 10 minutes. Some increased latency persisted during recovery but errors have returned to baseline. We're continuing to monitor and will share a full incident report within 48 hours."

lina-park (NovaGrid): thanks, appreciated. We'll wait for the post-mortem.

maria-sre: action items created: [INC-1767001234] 1) add autoscaler regression tests to infra CI; 2) add a dedicated alert for dedicated-cluster-scale-down-rates; 3) review runbook to include explicit pin-and-revert steps for enterprise clusters. Owners assigned.

kyle-sre: note for oncall handoff doc: when handling dedicated-customer 5xx spikes, first steps = (1) scale to baseline replicas, (2) check autoscaler change history, (3) revert config if recent change, (4) perform canary requests, (5) communicate to CSM. Adding to runbook now.

incident-bot: Incident moved to MONITORING. Root cause annotated as autoscaler configuration regression; follow-up ticket created INC-1767001234.

maria-sre: closing notes: please prepare the internal incident summary (ops + product + cs) and schedule a 30m blameless postmortem tomorrow. Good job on rapid mitigation everyone. :thumbsup:

kyle-sre: acknowledged. I captured command history and pasted into the incident ticket.

tara-cs: I'll share the customer-facing postmortem draft once internal review is done.

ops-bot: incident thread archived by ops-bot at 1767002000.
